title: About SPEDICS
intro: SPEDICS provides professionally structured training designed to develop practical knowledge, confidence and career-ready skills.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To empower educators and learners with practical skills to create better learning experiences and stronger futures.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To provide quality, practical and child-centred training that builds confident and competent professionals.

whyChoose.title: Structured Curriculum
whyChoose.text: Well-organised modules designed for progressive learning.

whyChoose.title: Practical Learning
whyChoose.text: Hands-on activities, demonstrations and real classroom strategies.

whyChoose.title: Online & Offline
whyChoose.text: Flexible modes to suit working professionals and homemakers.

whyChoose.title: Assessments
whyChoose.text: Assignments and evaluations to track your progress.

whyChoose.title: Trainer Guidance
whyChoose.text: Experienced mentors supporting you throughout the journey.

montessori.title: Why Montessori?
montessori.intro: Montessori education encourages independence, hands-on learning and respect for each child's individual development.
